info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: GetCompany returns the caller org's cap-table company record.
get.description:
GetCompany returns the caller org's cap-table company record. The row is
seeded when the tenant's store first opens, so it always exists; its name and
incorporation details are set with PUT /v1/captable/company.

get.summary: ListConvertibles returns the caller org's convertible notes, newest first.
get.description:
ListConvertibles returns the caller org's convertible notes, newest first. A
note's principal sits OUTSIDE issued equity until it converts, so it is not
part of the share counts.

delete.summary:
DeleteConvertible removes one of the caller org's convertible notes, taking its
principal out of the cap table's unconverted-instrument totals.
delete.description:
DeleteConvertible removes one of the caller org's convertible notes, taking its
principal out of the cap table's unconverted-instrument totals. An id this org
does not hold is not found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the convertible note to delete.

get.summary: ListEquityPlans returns the caller org's equity plans, newest first.
get.description:
ListEquityPlans returns the caller org's equity plans, newest first. An equity
plan is an option pool: a reserve of shares, drawn from one share class, that
option grants are written against.

get.summary: ListInvestments returns the caller org's investments, newest first.
get.description:
ListInvestments returns the caller org's investments, newest first. It spans
every round, so it is the flat ledger of cheques written into the company,
each naming its investor and the round it went into.

get.summary: ListOptions returns the caller org's option grants, newest first.
get.description:
ListOptions returns the caller org's option grants, newest first. Each row is
joined to its grantee and its equity plan. Grants that are EXERCISED, EXPIRED
or CANCELLED are listed here but do not dilute the cap table.

delete.summary:
DeleteOption removes one of the caller org's option grants, taking its shares
out of the cap table's granted-options and fully-diluted counts.
delete.description:
DeleteOption removes one of the caller org's option grants, taking its shares
out of the cap table's granted-options and fully-diluted counts. An id this org
does not hold is not found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the option grant to delete.

get.summary: ListRounds returns the caller org's fundraising rounds, newest first.
get.description:
ListRounds returns the caller org's fundraising rounds, newest first. A round
groups a fundraising event; a PRICED round also carries the share class and
price per share it issues at.

get.summary:
GetRound returns one of the caller org's fundraising rounds together with every
investment written into it, oldest first.
get.description:
GetRound returns one of the caller org's fundraising rounds together with every
investment written into it, oldest first. A round id that does not exist in the
caller's org is not found — including one that exists in another tenant, since
the org comes from the caller's principal and is part of the lookup.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
ID is the round to read. It is the path segment: the URL is the addressing
authority, and the org it is resolved in comes from the caller's principal,
so an id from another tenant is simply not found.

get.summary: ListSafes returns the caller org's SAFEs, newest first.
get.description:
ListSafes returns the caller org's SAFEs, newest first. A SAFE is a simple
agreement for future equity: its capital sits OUTSIDE issued equity until it
converts, so it is not part of the share counts.

delete.summary:
DeleteSafe removes one of the caller org's SAFEs, taking its capital out of the
cap table's unconverted-instrument totals.
delete.description:
DeleteSafe removes one of the caller org's SAFEs, taking its capital out of the
cap table's unconverted-instrument totals. An id this org does not hold is not
found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the SAFE to delete.

get.summary: ListShareClasses returns the caller org's share classes, in creation order.
get.description:
ListShareClasses returns the caller org's share classes, in creation order. A
share class is what a certificate is issued in, and every class the company
has authorized appears. The response is a bare JSON array, not an envelope.

get.summary: ListShares returns the caller org's share certificates, newest first.
get.description:
ListShares returns the caller org's share certificates, newest first. Each row
is joined to its holder and its share class, so a certificate names who holds
it and what class it is in without a second call.

delete.summary:
DeleteShare removes one of the caller org's share certificates, taking its
shares out of the cap table's outstanding and fully-diluted counts.
delete.description:
DeleteShare removes one of the caller org's share certificates, taking its
shares out of the cap table's outstanding and fully-diluted counts. An id this
org does not hold is not found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the share certificate to delete.

get.summary: ListStakeholders returns the caller org's stakeholders, newest first.
get.description:
ListStakeholders returns the caller org's stakeholders, newest first. The
response is a bare JSON array, not an envelope. Each row carries the holder's
contact and address fields alongside the company's name.

delete.summary: DeleteStakeholder removes one of the caller org's stakeholders.
delete.description:
DeleteStakeholder removes one of the caller org's stakeholders. It REFUSES to
orphan issued equity: a holder that still holds share certificates or option
grants cannot be deleted, and answers 400 saying so — release or transfer the
holdings first. An id this org does not hold is not found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the stakeholder to delete.

get.summary: GetSummary computes the caller org's cap table.
get.description:
GetSummary computes the caller org's cap table. It answers who owns what on a
fully-diluted basis: outstanding shares, granted options, per-stakeholder
ownership percentages, each share class's authorized versus issued position,
and the capital sitting on SAFEs and convertible notes that have not yet
converted. Only non-terminal option grants dilute — EXERCISED, EXPIRED and
CANCELLED grants are excluded, so equity issued through an exercised option is
never counted twice.

authorized.description: Authorized is how many shares of the class are authorized.

issued.description: Issued is how many shares of the class have been issued.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is when the company row was seeded, in unix milliseconds.

id.description: ID is the company id, which is the tenant's own org id.

incorporationCountry.description: IncorporationCountry is the ISO country the entity is incorporated in.

incorporationState.description: IncorporationState is the state or province of incorporation.

incorporationType.description: IncorporationType is the entity kind, e.g. LLC or C_CORP.

name.description: Name is the company's legal name.

publicId.description: PublicID is the company's shareable public identifier.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is when the company row last changed, in unix milliseconds.

notes.description: Notes is the convertible notes total.

success.description: Success is true when the row was removed.

boardApprovalDate.description: BoardApprovalDate is the ISO date the board approved the plan.

comments.description: Comments is free-form notes on the plan.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is when the plan was recorded, in unix milliseconds.

defaultCancellatonBehavior.description:
DefaultCancellatonBehavior is what happens to cancelled grants, RETIRE or
RETURN_TO_POOL. The key is spelled as the cap-table wire spells it.

id.description: ID is the equity plan id.

initialSharesReserved.description: InitialSharesReserved is how many shares the plan reserves.

name.description: Name is the plan name, e.g. "2026 Stock Option Plan".

planEffectiveDate.description: PlanEffectiveDate is the ISO date the plan takes effect.

shareClassId.description: ShareClassID is the class the reserved shares come from.

data.description: Data is every equity plan on the caller org's cap table, newest first.

options.description: Options is the shares under this stakeholder's non-terminal option grants.

ownershipPct.description:
OwnershipPct is fullyDiluted as a percentage of the company's
fullyDilutedShares, rounded to two decimals; 0 when nothing is issued.

shares.description: Shares is the shares this stakeholder holds by certificate.

capital.description: Capital is the total capital across those instruments.

count.description: Count is how many instruments there are.

date.description: Date is the ISO date of the investment.

roundId.description: RoundID is the round the cheque went into.

shareClassId.description: ShareClassID is the class shares were issued in, for a priced round.

shares.description:
Shares is how many shares the investment bought; 0 when the round issues
no equity at the time of investment.

data.description: Data is every investment across every round, newest first.

capital.description: Capital is the principal the investor lent.

conversionCap.description: ConversionCap is the valuation cap on conversion, if any.

discountRate.description: DiscountRate is the discount to the next round's price, if any.

interestRate.description: InterestRate is the annual interest rate, if any.

issueDate.description: IssueDate is the ISO date the note was signed.

publicId.description: PublicID is the note's shareable identifier, unique within the company.

status.description: Status is the note's state, e.g. DRAFT or ACTIVE.

type.description: Type is the instrument kind, e.g. NOTE.

data.description: Data is every convertible note, newest first.

cliffYears.description: CliffYears is how many years before any of the grant vests.

equityPlanId.description: EquityPlanID is the plan the grant draws from.

exercisePrice.description: ExercisePrice is the strike price per share.

expirationDate.description: ExpirationDate is the ISO date the grant expires.

grantId.description: GrantID is the grant number, unique within the company.

issueDate.description: IssueDate is the ISO date the grant was issued.

quantity.description: Quantity is how many shares the grant covers.

status.description:
Status is the grant's state, e.g. DRAFT, ACTIVE, EXERCISED, EXPIRED or
CANCELLED. Only non-terminal grants dilute the cap table.

type.description: Type is the grant kind, ISO or NSO.

vestingYears.description: VestingYears is the total vesting period in years.

data.description: Data is every option grant, newest first.

closeDate.description: CloseDate is the ISO date the round closed, once it has.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is when the round was recorded, in unix milliseconds.

name.description: Name is the round name, e.g. "Series A".

preMoneyValuation.description: PreMoneyValuation is the pre-money valuation, for a priced round.

pricePerShare.description: PricePerShare is the price per share, for a priced round.

raisedAmount.description: RaisedAmount is how much has been invested so far.

roundType.description: RoundType is PRICED, SAFE or CONVERTIBLE_NOTE.

shareClassId.description: ShareClassID is the class a priced round issues into.

targetAmount.description: TargetAmount is how much the round set out to raise.

investments.description: Investments is every investment into this round, oldest first.

comments.description: Comments is the note recorded with the cheque, if any.

date.description: Date is the ISO date of the investment.

shares.description:
Shares is how many shares the investment bought; 0 when the round issues no
equity at the time of investment.

count.description: Count is how many rounds the company has recorded.

totalRaised.description: TotalRaised is the sum of every round's raised amount.

data.description: Data is every round, newest first.

capital.description: Capital is the cash the investor put in.

discountRate.description: DiscountRate is the discount to the next round's price, if any.

issueDate.description: IssueDate is the ISO date the SAFE was signed.

mfn.description: MFN is true when the SAFE carries a most-favoured-nation clause.

proRata.description: ProRata is true when the SAFE carries pro-rata rights.

publicId.description: PublicID is the SAFE's shareable identifier, unique within the company.

status.description: Status is the SAFE's state, e.g. DRAFT or ACTIVE.

valuationCap.description: ValuationCap is the valuation cap, if any.

data.description: Data is every SAFE, newest first.

capitalContribution.description: CapitalContribution is the cash paid for the certificate, if recorded.

certificateId.description: CertificateID is the certificate number, unique within the company.

companyLegends.description: CompanyLegends are the restrictive legends printed on the certificate.

issueDate.description: IssueDate is the ISO date the certificate was issued.

pricePerShare.description: PricePerShare is the price paid per share, if recorded.

quantity.description: Quantity is how many shares the certificate covers.

shareClassId.description: ShareClassID is the class the shares belong to.

shareClassType.description: ShareClassType is that class's type, COMMON or PREFERRED.

stakeholderId.description: StakeholderID is the holder of the certificate.

companyName.description: CompanyName is the name of the company whose cap table this is.

conversionRights.description:
ConversionRights describes what the class converts into, e.g.
CONVERTS_TO_FUTURE_ROUND.

id.description: ID is the share class id.

idx.description: Idx is the class's 1-based position within the company, in creation order.

initialSharesAuthorized.description: InitialSharesAuthorized is how many shares of this class are authorized.

liquidationPreferenceMultiple.description: LiquidationPreferenceMultiple is the preference multiple on liquidation.

name.description: Name is the class name, e.g. "Common" or "Series A Preferred".

parValue.description: ParValue is the par value per share.

participationCapMultiple.description: ParticipationCapMultiple caps participation on liquidation; 0 is uncapped.

prefix.description: Prefix is the certificate prefix, CS for common and PS for preferred.

pricePerShare.description: PricePerShare is the issue price per share.

seniority.description: Seniority orders classes in a liquidation waterfall; higher is more senior.

votesPerShare.description: VotesPerShare is how many votes one share of this class carries.

data.description: Data is every issued share certificate, newest first.

city.description: City is the stakeholder's city, if recorded.

companyName.description: CompanyName is the name of the company whose cap table this is.

country.description: Country is the stakeholder's two-letter country code.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is when the stakeholder was added, in unix milliseconds.

currentRelationship.description:
CurrentRelationship is how the stakeholder relates to the company, e.g.
FOUNDER, INVESTOR or EMPLOYEE.

email.description: Email is the stakeholder's email, unique within the company.

institutionName.description: InstitutionName names the institution, when the stakeholder is one.

name.description: Name is the stakeholder's full name.

state.description: State is the stakeholder's state or province, if recorded.

streetAddress.description: StreetAddress is the stakeholder's street address, if recorded.

taxId.description: TaxID is the stakeholder's tax identifier, if recorded.

zipcode.description: Zipcode is the stakeholder's postal code, if recorded.

byShareClass.description:
ByShareClass is each share class's authorized-versus-issued position, in
class creation order.

byStakeholder.description: ByStakeholder is each stakeholder's position, largest holding first.

company.description: Company names the company the cap table is computed for.

convertibles.description: Convertibles is the capital on SAFEs and notes that have not converted.

totals.description: Totals is the company-wide share count.

id.description: ID is the company id, which is the tenant's own org id.

name.description: Name is the company's legal name.

grantedOptions.description:
GrantedOptions is the shares under non-terminal option grants — grants that
are EXERCISED, EXPIRED or CANCELLED are excluded, so nothing double-counts.

outstandingShares.description: OutstandingShares is the sum of every issued share certificate.

shareClasses.description: ShareClasses is how many share classes the company has authorized.

stakeholders.description: Stakeholders is how many stakeholders the company has.
